title: Graphox Configuration
description: Configuration for Graphox, a high-performance GraphQL toolset.

projects.description: Project configurations. Projects are matched in order; the first matching project is used for each file.

schema_types.description: Generate standalone TypeScript types from the schema without operations.

scalars.description: Map GraphQL scalar types to TypeScript types.

ignore_deprecations.description: Suppress warnings for deprecated fields or types globally.

watch_all_files.description: Whether to watch all workspace files for changes. If false, only GraphQL files are watched.

lsp_automatic_codegen.description: Whether to automatically run codegen on file changes in the LSP.

lsp_codegen_throttle_ms.description: Throttle automatic codegen in the LSP (ms).

codegen_watch_debounce_ms.description: Debounce file changes in watch mode (ms).

enable_schema_cache.description: Enable two-tier schema cache for better performance.

codegen.description: Codegen configuration. Set to false to disable codegen globally.

schema.description: Single schema file path or an array of paths for multi-file schemas.

include.description: Glob pattern(s) for GraphQL operations to include in this project.

exclude.description: Glob pattern(s) for files to exclude from this project.

output_dir.description: Directory where generated files will be placed.

import.description: The import path used by other projects to reference fragments from this project.

codegen.description: Codegen configuration for this project. Set to false to disable codegen.

possible_types.description: Path to generate possibleTypes introspection data for Apollo Client's InMemoryCache.

type_policies.description: Path to generate strict TypeScript types for Apollo Client TypePolicies.

output.description: File path where schema types will be generated.

import.description: How generated files import these types.

possible_types.description: Path to generate possibleTypes introspection data for Apollo Client.

type_policies.description: Path to generate Apollo Client TypePolicies.

required_fields.description: Enforce required fields in selections. Can be a boolean shorthand or a map of field names to rules.

unique_operation_name.description: Enforce unique names for all operations across the project.

no_duplicate_fields.description: Prevent selecting the same field multiple times in a single selection set.

no_unused_fragments.description: Identify and error on fragments that are defined but not used.

oneOf.description: Whether this field is always required.
List of operation types (query, mutation, subscription) where this field is required.

document_suffix.description: Suffix for the generated document constant.

variables_suffix.description: Suffix for the generated variables type.

fragment_suffix.description: Suffix for the generated fragment type.

fragment_document_suffix.description: Suffix for the generated fragment document constant.

query_suffix.description: Suffix for the generated query type.

mutation_suffix.description: Suffix for the generated mutation type.

subscription_suffix.description: Suffix for the generated subscription type.

fragment_masking.description: Enable fragment masking to prevent fragment fields from 'leaking' into parent operation types.

unmask_function_name.description: Custom function name for unmasking fragment data.

generate_ast_for_fragments.description: Generate and reuse AST nodes for fragments to reduce bundle sizes.

re_exports.description: Re-export all operation and fragment types/documents from the root graphql.ts file.

default_scalar_type.description: Default type for scalars not defined in 'scalars' mapping.

schema_import.description: The import path used in generated operation files to reference schema types.

threshold_ms.description: Only trace requests exceeding this threshold in milliseconds.
